Name: Animal Catalogue - Buy Animals Anywhere in Bulk
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center][/center][size=3]This mod is requested by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/4momo]4momo[/url], thanks for the cool idea! :P 
[/size]

[b][center][size=6]Mass Purchase Animals Anywhere - The Animal Catalogue[/size][/center][/b]
[center][size=3]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url][/size][/center]

[quote][size=3]﻿If you have animals in buildings you don't want them to be in, you can simply relocate them by clicking on them or use this mod to do a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41425?tab=description]mass relocation: Mass Animal Mover [/url]﻿[/size][/quote]


Are you a rancher planning to fill 4 Deluxe Barns with Pigs? Are you tired of clicking through Marnie's dialogue, selecting a building, and typing a name for every single chicken?

[b]Mass Purchase Animals Anywhere[/b] adds a convenient new menu, the [b]Animal Catalogue[/b], allowing you to buy animals in bulk instantly, from anywhere in the world. No more repetitive clicking!

[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41457/41457-1768847958-1664019644.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[size=4][b]Features
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Bulk Buying:[/b] Select an animal, choose a quantity, and buy them all at once. The gold is deducted, and the animals appear in your barn immediately.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Works Anywhere:[/b] Default hotkey is [b]F7[/b]. You can open the catalogue from your farm, the mines, or Ginger Island. You do not need to visit Marnie's shop.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Auto-Naming:[/b] Skips the naming screen entirely. Animals are automatically given random names (just like the dice roll in the vanilla menu).
[/list][list]
[*][b]Smart Building Selection:[/b] The mod scans your entire world (including Ginger Island and SVE locations) to find barns and coops with available space.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Mod Support:[/b] Automatically detects modded animals (like those from BFAV or expansion mods) as long as they are in the game data.
[/list][center][youtube]bVebHvAwAFo[/youtube]﻿[/center][size=4][b]How to Use
[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Press [b]F7[/b] (configurable) to open the Animal Catalogue.

[*]Select the animal you want from the grid on the left.

[*]Use the arrows to select the destination building (Barn, Coop, etc.).

[*]Use the [b]+[/b] / [b]-[/b] buttons to choose how many you want.

[*]Click the [b]Buy[/b] button.

[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41457/41457-1768848294-1188866507.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[/list][size=4][b]Configuration
[/b][/size]
You can change the hotkey using [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] in-game, or by editing the config.json file.

[size=4][b]Installation
[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].

[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.

[*]Run the game.

[/list][size=4][b]Compatibility
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] is required.
[*]Compatible with [b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b].
[*]Compatible with [b]Ginger Island[/b] farms.
[*]Compatible with custom animal mods.
[*]Safe to install and uninstall at any time (does not permanently alter save data).
[/list]
